Step out of the woods, walk straight through the gate and you’re right into the heart of the action. Wander through the Circus Fields towards West Holts, or head straight for the Pyramid Stage in under 15 minutes. And because we’re on the east side of the festival, we’re perfectly placed for the late-night areas of Shangri-La and Block9. When you’re finally ready to call it a night, you can be back at Folly Woods in 15 minutes – straight into your cosy canvas bell tent, or stopping at The Folly for one last nightcap.
